items.label: 【Extensive DIY Terrarium Craft Kit】
items.value: Our craft kit includes everything girls need to build and customize their unicorn terrarium. items.label: 【Multi-functional Night Light】
items.value: Watch the LED lights bring your terrarium to life. In addition to incandescent light, it has an additional 12 color lighting options. And it features 2 flashing modes, 2 timer modes, and 5 levels of brightness adjustment. It can be controlled remotely with a remote control.so your kids can choose their favorite lighting mode to create a colorful glow that will capture their attention. The timer function provides added convenience based on your child's sleeping habits.

items.label: 【Engaging & Screen-Free Activity】
items.value: Keep your kids away from excessive screen time with this captivating DIY craft kit. It provides hours of creative fun and allows them to immerse themselves in a hands-on project that sparks their imagination. As they design and assemble their terrarium, kids will not only have a blast but also enhance their artistic and crafting skills.

items.label: 【Unique Bedroom Decor】
items.value: This Unicorn Terrarium Kit is not just a craft project, but also a beautiful addition to any girl's bedroom. It can be placed near a bedside table, emitting a gentle glow that soothes and comforts. It adds a touch of magic and creates a cozy and enchanting atmosphere that girls will love.
